label: Violent or Graphic Content
description:
We know that people have different sensitivities with regard to graphic and violent imagery. In the context of art, we allow graphic content (with some limitations) to help people to condemn and raise awareness about important issues such as human rights abuses, etc.

To protect users from disturbing imagery, we add a warning label to some graphic or violent imagery so that people are aware it may be sensitive before they click through.

If you believe this artwork be a violent or graphic, please proceed to submit report.

label: Hateful or Abusive Content
description:
Foster Marketplace does not tolerate any form of hateful or abusive content.

If you believe this artwork be a hateful or abusive, please proceed to submit report.

label: Graphic Sexual Content
description:
We know that people have different sensitivities with regard to graphic sexual content. In consideration of users with these sensitivities, we add a warning label to some graphic sexual content so that people are aware it may be sensitive before they click through.

If you believe this artwork contains graphic sexual content, please proceed to submit report.
